frameworks.name: MCP
frameworks.interception: Server middleware before decorated handler; verify normalized arguments and execute those values.
frameworks.released: Released client/middleware exist; client could call without a warrant in scope. SDK major, decorator shape, metadata and canonicalization must match.
frameworks.main: Client now fails closed without warrant; SDK 2 server middleware verifies decorator defaults/validators. Main remains authoritative only for its checkout.
frameworks.minimum_framework_versions: mcp>=1.9.4; FastMCP>=3.2.1; separate MCP 1/FastMCP 3 and MCP 2/FastMCP 4 environments.
frameworks.known_bypasses: Client-only checks do not secure a raw server; optional-warrant/observe paths permit effects. Do not adopt proposed envelope v2.
frameworks.deny_before_effect_evidence: Real dispatch/effect-counter coverage exists in tests/agent-skills/tenuo-agent-authorization/frameworks/test_mcp.py; versioned runs and native artifact hashes are recorded separately. This covers the named paths only.

frameworks.name: LangChain
frameworks.interception: create_agent middleware from tenuo.langgraph; legacy executors need verified guarded tool rebuilding.
frameworks.released: TenuoMiddleware supports create_agent when available. guard_agent fallback can keep original unguarded tools; never infer protection from wrapped .tools.
frameworks.main: No merged adapter change since pin; pending enforcement stack still matters.
frameworks.minimum_framework_versions: langchain>=1 for create_agent middleware; legacy extra langchain/core>=0.2 does not provide that API.
frameworks.known_bypasses: guard_agent/auto_protect fallback, global mode changes and original handler access; use middleware/effect guard with actual dispatch tests.
frameworks.deny_before_effect_evidence: Real dispatch/effect-counter coverage exists in tests/agent-skills/tenuo-agent-authorization/frameworks/test_langgraph.py; versioned runs and native artifact hashes are recorded separately. This covers the named paths only.

frameworks.name: LangGraph
frameworks.interception: TenuoToolNode per tool call with state schema retaining warrant and parent chain.
frameworks.released: ToolNode hook is feature detected. guard_node binds state/key and optional capability check; it is not full node authorization. @tenuo_node config injection is broken.
frameworks.main: guard_node config forwarding merged; @tenuo_node fix, stack-token parsing and full guard_node verification remain pending.
frameworks.minimum_framework_versions: Other APIs extra langgraph>=0.2/core>=0.2.27; TenuoToolNode actually needs langgraph-prebuilt>=1.0.2 hook. Verify features; pending floor changes.
frameworks.known_bypasses: Raw handlers/effect clients bypass ToolNode; node binding alone does not check trust/expiry/arguments. Do not use node wrapper as effect boundary.
frameworks.deny_before_effect_evidence: Real dispatch/effect-counter coverage exists in tests/agent-skills/tenuo-agent-authorization/frameworks/test_langgraph.py; versioned runs and native artifact hashes are recorded separately. This covers the named paths only.

frameworks.name: OpenAI Agents
frameworks.interception: Per-function tool input guardrail through guard_agent when exported; protect downstream handlers otherwise.
frameworks.released: Agent input_guardrails guidance cannot intercept later tool calls; guard_agent is absent in the matching tag.
frameworks.main: guard_agent mediates function/MCP tools and reachable handoff target tools; refuses unsupported hosted tools. Handoff transition itself is not a separately scoped capability.
frameworks.minimum_framework_versions: openai extra declares agents>=0.1; guard_agent requires function tool guardrails (source says >=0.3.3). Runner tested at 0.22.0, whose MCPServerStdio lacks the required MCP hook and is refused. Check features per tool type.
frameworks.known_bypasses: Agent input guardrail is not tool authorization; local hooks do not isolate raw handlers. MCP attachment tests alone do not prove dispatch.
frameworks.deny_before_effect_evidence: Real dispatch/effect-counter coverage exists in tests/agent-skills/tenuo-agent-authorization/frameworks/test_openai.py; versioned runs and native artifact hashes are recorded separately. This covers the named paths only.

frameworks.name: Temporal
frameworks.interception: Activity inbound interceptor before body, with workflow outbound signing and public chain headers.
frameworks.released: Transport/interceptors exist; helper chain conventions differ. Start helper cannot accept pending warrant_chain option. dry_run and replayer need path-specific checks.
frameworks.main: Adapter fixes include mapping/constraint validation, bounded key cache and native changes; main plugin extra floors temporalio at 1.33.0 despite stale matrix/docs.
frameworks.minimum_framework_versions: Current pyproject temporalio>=1.33.0 for plugin SimplePlugin. Matrix claims 1.23.0; do not use that as evidence.
frameworks.known_bypasses: Missing workflow parents, mixed-worker sandbox extension replacement and replay key resolution; internal/injected argument exemptions and observe are pending.
frameworks.deny_before_effect_evidence: Real dispatch/effect-counter coverage exists in tests/agent-skills/tenuo-agent-authorization/frameworks/test_temporal.py; versioned runs and native artifact hashes are recorded separately. This covers the named paths only.

frameworks.name: CrewAI
frameworks.interception: Before-tool hook must return framework terminal denial; prefer effect service until real kickoff/Flow proof.
frameworks.released: GuardedCrew/hooks exist; hook exceptions and async hooks may allow execution; per-agent parent transport gaps.
frameworks.main: No merged CrewAI adapter change since pin; pending fail-closed leaf is material.
frameworks.minimum_framework_versions: crewai>=1.5 for hooks; dependency constraints keep MCP 1/OpenAI<3 in separate environment.
frameworks.known_bypasses: Unexpected hook exceptions/coroutines, async Flow guard lifetime, raw effect route, missing parent chain.
frameworks.deny_before_effect_evidence: Existing adapter tests are not a replacement for real kickoff/async Flow effect counts; those gap-specific tests are on the pending fail-closed stack.

frameworks.name: Google ADK
frameworks.interception: before_tool/plugin with full argument mapping and scope; downstream handler for unresolved gaps.
frameworks.released: Guard/plugin exist; closed-world local constraints and ScopedWarrant scope have pending gaps.
frameworks.main: No merged ADK guard change since pin; observe/approval/scope fixes remain open.
frameworks.minimum_framework_versions: google-adk>=0.1 declared; verify installed runner/callback API, tested matrix reports 2.8.
frameworks.known_bypasses: ScopedWarrant scope without plugin, unlisted/runtime arguments, approval errors; require_pop=False does not verify holder proof.
frameworks.deny_before_effect_evidence: An existing InMemoryRunner test exercises dispatch; pending scope/closed-world/approval fixes need their own real-runner proof.

frameworks.name: AutoGen
frameworks.interception: Guard each dispatched tool, including async/stream paths; service boundary for process compromise.
frameworks.released: GuardBuilder/tool wrappers exist; configure independent roots and pass delegated parents.
frameworks.main: Merged audit hardening and audit callback error isolation; explicit entrypoint roots/observe records remain pending.
frameworks.known_bypasses: Retained original tool and unguarded stream/direct routes; log/skip denial evidence differs across versions.
frameworks.deny_before_effect_evidence: Existing tests require inspection and execution; no blanket certification. See adapter regression results for exact cases.

frameworks.name: FastAPI
frameworks.interception: Dependency at every effecting HTTP route, verified final typed arguments.
frameworks.released: Guard/router exist; strict=True ignored and add_api_route/include_router may bypass SecureAPIRouter decorators.
frameworks.main: Merged typed argument/transport fixes do not fix router coverage; strict audit and all-route leaf remain open.
frameworks.minimum_framework_versions: fastapi>=0.100 declared; inspect Starlette/route dispatch in target.
frameworks.known_bypasses: Included/late-added routes, mounts, websockets and direct endpoint calls need coverage; router symbol is no certificate.
frameworks.deny_before_effect_evidence: Existing tests require inspection and execution; no blanket certification. See adapter regression results for exact cases.

frameworks.name: A2A
frameworks.interception: Receiving ASGI task/skill handler with root trust, full chain, PoP and server constraints before effect.
frameworks.released: Audience default, server constraints under PoP and trust_delegated stack path have pending corrections.
frameworks.main: Client compatibility with latest Starlette merged; server gaps remain.
frameworks.minimum_framework_versions: In-repo A2A uses httpx>=0.24 and starlette>=0.27, not an upstream A2A SDK.
frameworks.known_bypasses: Server ceiling skipped under PoP; JTI consumed before authorization; missing chain must not be fixed with intermediate roots.
frameworks.deny_before_effect_evidence: Existing tests require inspection and execution; no blanket certification. See adapter regression results for exact cases.

frameworks.name: Hermes
frameworks.interception: Plugin pre_tool_call for covered user tools; independently guard ctx.dispatch_tool effects.
frameworks.released: Separately shipped hermes-tenuo; this repository release does not pin its installed source.
frameworks.main: No in-repo adapter; external plugin version/commit and dispatch tests required.
frameworks.minimum_framework_versions: Matrix: Hermes>=0.20, hermes-tenuo 0.1.3 requires tenuo>=0.3.2; verify external packaging.
frameworks.known_bypasses: Plugin ctx.dispatch_tool calls bypass pre_tool_call; external nightly compatibility is not this skill regression proof.
frameworks.deny_before_effect_evidence: Existing tests require inspection and execution; no blanket certification. See adapter regression results for exact cases.

guidance_review.basis: Reviewed handwritten guidance routes known adapter gaps to installed-source inspection, real dispatch proof, and effect-boundary enforcement. No pending replacement API is prescribed as installed behavior.
